# Knowledge Canvas

> Knowledge Canvas is an open-source, local-first AI learning workspace built on an infinite canvas. It organizes branching AI conversations, PDFs, Markdown, OCR text, and mirrored real provider web sessions in one spatial workspace.

- Repository: https://github.com/LaplaceYoung/knowledge-canvas
- License: MIT
- Status: alpha / self-hosted
- Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, React Flow, assistant-ui, shadcn/ui

## What it does

Knowledge Canvas preserves the source relationship between a question and the material that produced it. A user can select text from an AI answer, PDF, Markdown, TXT, or OCR result, then create a follow-up chat branch that retains the quoted passage and source location.

Core capabilities:

- Infinite canvas with pan, zoom, resize, minimap, and semantic zoom.
- Branching AI chat with streaming, stop, retry, Markdown, GFM, LaTeX, and code copy.
- PDF, Markdown, and TXT document nodes.
- Scanned PDF OCR through PaddleOCR cloud or self-hosted PaddleX, with page-anchored results.
- Multiple persisted canvases with a collapsible left sidebar for creating, pinning, reordering, deleting, and switching.
- A settings panel for LLM, search (TinyFish, Exa, DeepSeek, Bocha), PaddleOCR, and ACP keys/configuration.
- Web nodes that bind real ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, and Kimi tabs through a Chrome extension. Every bound provider can be prompted from the node, mirror visible messages, and expose page-level model, thinking, or search controls.
- BYOK OpenAI-compatible model endpoints through a same-origin proxy.
- Session-only API keys, local canvas persistence, and no cookie access by the extension.
- ACP local-agent connection preflight; full agent chat execution is not yet implemented.

## Architecture

The browser app talks to a same-origin Node/Vite server for model, OCR, and agent routes. A browser extension bridges the canvas to real provider tabs with a fixed command allowlist. Web nodes are not iframes.

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/LaplaceYoung/knowledge-canvas.git
cd knowledge-canvas/app
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open http://127.0.0.1:3000. Load the unpacked extension from the repository's `extension/` directory for Web nodes.

Production-style server:

```bash
npm run build
npm start
```

## Security boundaries

- The extension does not read cookies, authorization headers, or provider tokens.
- Provider credentials are not written to the canvas.
- A public deployment must add authentication and rate limiting to `/api/*`.
- "Local canvas" does not imply local model inference.
